notes.title: NEW GLITCH UPDATE COMING!
notes.content:
NEW UPDATE TO GLITCH! Now this one is HUGE. As you know... Glitch doesn't seem like an original game. Despite its insane story. It feels too much like other games. 

I have been working for a long time and I am completely refreshing the game. Basically, I deleted the game and am re-starting from scratch. Yeah...

The game has a new style, new building that is 2X bigger, it runs around 5X faster... etc

Now, this update is far from ready.. I am hoping to get it out before December.

In the mean time, I have set up an OFFICIAL GLITCH SERVER that you can see more progress, updates and more.

https://discord.gg/ssNjf4g

If want to play this game for you channel... THANKS! But I strongly recommend that you wait until this new update comes out. As it stands... the game seems unfinished and gross. I am working with other SUCCESSFUL game-devs to make Glitch truly the best it can be.

Thanks.

:))

notes.title: Update Log
notes.content:
So apparently steam doesn't have a update log thing (Or I haven't found it yet) so I'll just update this post.


V2.03 - The BETTER update

- Added more jump scares. Cause why not!

- Gave the character glasses. So the walls don't look as blurry

- Bought the character new shoes. His old ones were too loud!

- Added more friends for you to find.

- Added LORE! 

- Made the game render faster. (I hope)

- Added the story! (Why wasn't this in the original?)

- Removed an effect that caused the game to lag.

- Added some lore in some audio that may or may not play during hallucinations. :)

- Hallucinations now either predict the future, or tell the past. Not all of this is clear though.

- Covered the game in lotion to make it smoother.

- Got a new flashlight... but its kinda flickery

- Made the Player's head glow blue. Sounds weird buts its worth it.

- Does anyone even READ these?

- Taught the player how to properly hold a flashlight

- Kept the troll

- When the elevator stops. LOOK UP

- Fixed Clearwater's name

- Gave the player credit for once

- New ACHIEVEMENT!

- Oh yea... added a VOLUME SLIDER!

- A few more things I forgot :P

- Took a hammer and squashed some bugs (I probably created new ones too)

- Made the way more clear in some parts

- Pretty sure I fixed the black screen bug.
